## Checklist (all required)

- [ ] Linked issue approved by the owner
- [ ] CLA signed
- [ ] No new colours, spacing or springs outside tokens.json
- [ ] No Anthropic or Claude assets, no copied doc text
- [ ] British English, no em or en dashes in copy
- [ ] Tests added or updated; golden matcher tests still pass
- [ ] Works at 360px; primary action in the thumb zone
- [ ] axe passes; keyboard path exists
- [ ] No new dependency, or justified below
- [ ] No change to CODEOWNERS, rulesets, licence, CLA or CI without a prior approved issue
